text:
Maya L.: Quick design review on the metrics panel: legend and axis nitpick. The current layout pushes the chart down when there are many series. Thoughts?
Ethan W.: Could we move units inline near axis ticks instead of in the legend? Legend should be purely series toggles.
Noor A.: Inline axis units are good, but they need hover/focus expansion for full text (e.g., "requests per second (rps)").
Felix P.: Also smoothing — users keep missing that it's enabled. Suggest showing a tiny badge on the chart header: "Smoothing x0.3" so it's obvious.
Maya L.: Badge is smart. For outliers we currently clip with a caret; people thought it was a visual glitch. Maybe show a subtle overlay gradient at the edge + footer line "N hidden outliers".
Ethan W.: Footer pill should be interactive: keyboard focus opens a modal with the extreme rows and exact values.
Noor A.: Accessibility: any interactive legend must support roving tabindex and announce state changes. Use aria-pressed on items toggling visibility.
Felix P.: Copy nit: instead of "clip" use "Hide extreme values" in the UI. Less technical.
Maya L.: For dense legends propose two options: 1) condensed inline with small swatches + truncated names, 2) grouped legend with collapse/expand per group. Both behind "Legend style" setting.
Ethan W.: Can we auto-switch to condensed at widths < 760px? Also expose "Expand" action as "+X more series" with aria-expanded.
Noor A.: Make sure tooltip content is reachable by keyboard (enter/space) and SR reads full name + color + visibility state.
Felix P.: Implementation note: when exporting PNG/PDF, legends should expand to full names. Otherwise exports are useless for reports.
Maya L.: Telemetry ask: log when users toggle smoothing or legend style so we can see defaults. Noor, can you include a11y test cases in the spec?
Noor A.: Yep, I'll add keyboard flows, ARIA attributes list, and a small test matrix (NVDA/VoiceOver/JAWS).
Ethan W.: I'll prototype condensed + grouped variants in codepen and share CSS for pill overflow handling.
Felix P.: I'll update copy: "Smoothing intensity" slider label + helper: "Reduce short-term noise; increases blur of spikes." Also change "Clip" -> "Hide extreme values".
Maya L.: Plan: 1) add header badge for smoothing + slider; 2) condensed/grouped legend modes + auto switch; 3) interactive "Hidden outliers: N" footer; 4) ARIA and keyboard flows; 5) export expands legends. Target: prototype in 1 week.
aria-bot: Tagging @noor for accessibility review and @ethan for prototype. :white_check_mark:
Noor A.: I'll deliver the a11y doc tomorrow morning.
Ethan W.: Sharing the prototype by EOD Friday.
Maya L.: Great, thanks everyone.
